description: Create a short link with its own link preview. Optional custom slug, and optional A/B variants (each with a title, description, imageUrl or templateId) to test which preview gets more clicks. Returns id, shortUrl and variants. Use the id with get_link_stats.

destination.description: The destination URL the short link redirects to.

slug.description: A custom slug for the short link: lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, starting with a letter or digit.

variants.description: Up to 3 A/B preview variants, each with its own title, description, image or template, to test which preview gets more clicks.

params.description: Text values for this variant template's placeholders, keyed by placeholder name.

templateId.description: The template id used to render this variant's preview image.

name: create_short_link
